cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Can you understand why I kept rewriting a message you'd never answered, trying to become easier to reply to?

mechanism: A confidently sets the terms of a reunion conversation while lowering the verbal demand so B stays engaged in acknowledging what silence did.
confusable: Unlike merely seeking renewed contact, A pursues acknowledgment of emotional cost; borrowed authority concedes wording while maintaining the topic.
comparison: Long silence and difficulty speaking differ from a concert whose recording supplies observable evidence.
seedUse: Use D75-b broken phone/unanswered messages and S02-b adapting the participation method to B limits.
